user_prompt: In adults with coronary heart disease, heart failure, or atrial fibrillation, what is the effect of a psychological intervention (delivered alone, with cardiac rehabilitation, or with pharmacotherapy) compared with no psychological intervention on depression symptoms at follow-up (6 to 12 months after randomisation)? Treat all validated depression measures (e.g., BDI, BDI-II, BDI-FS, CDS, HADS-D, HAM-D, PHQ-9, ZDS) as measures of one common depression construct and pool them using standardized mean difference (SMD) rather than separating by instrument. Use one eligible depression endpoint per intervention-control comparison, using the longest available eligible follow-up between 6 and 12 months. Evaluate ONLY depression. Do not extract, classify, or pool anxiety, health-related quality of life, self-efficacy, mortality, major adverse cardiovascular events, or any other outcome.
